notes.title: Closed Beta Summary - thank you for participation!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33189349/a8a61e14f8321d51590e551b198353ed8ac502c2.png[/img]

Greetings, Hunters!

We are truly thankful for your participation and interest in our closed beta. We have sent 500 beta keys and we had to close the beta registration due to on-going interest. Your support, kind words, all the small reviews and YouTube videos inspire us to keep up the work and polish this game as much as possible. Thank you!

Of course we are aware that there is still a lot of work ahead of us. That's why we have decided to prioritize fixing some aspects of the game, accordingly to your feedback. In the next few months, we will focus on the following elements:
[list]
[*] Introducing UI elements that will help players finding a correct path to their next objective.
[*] Improving animations dynamics and fluidity. 
[*] Improving gameplay dynamics with the main focus being the combat dynamics.
[*] Improving and adjusting sound volume and sound quality.
[*] Fixing all of the bugs that are preventing players from having a normal, stable gameplay. 
[/list]

Stay tuned for the next updates! 

Best Regards, 
Reptiles: In Hunt Team
